{"metadata":{"description":"OpenAI-compatible HTTP surface for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/responses, GET /v1/models over the harness webServer + llm runtime","id":"gh:1348351830","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-openai-api","slug":"huyang2024/dsh-openai-api","topics":["chat-completions","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llm-gateway","openai","openai-api","responses-api"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"OpenAI-compatible HTTP surface for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/respo"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nses, GET /v1/models over the harness webServer + llm runtime"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-openai-api"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"OpenAI-compatible HTTP surface for DeepSeek Harness, backed by **real DSH agent sessions**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"After this plugin is installed into a dsh profile, the harness web server additionally serves:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| Endpoint | Purpose |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | Chat Completions API (streaming + non-streaming) |
| `POST /v1/respo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"nses` | Responses API subset (streaming + non-streaming) |
| `GET /v1/models` | Advertised model id "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ses` | Responses API subset (streaming + non-streaming) |
| `GET /v1/models` | Advertised model id |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"It also adds an **API** row at the sidebar foot (above Settings) showing the live base URL and port "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"— see Sidebar panel."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What "agent-backed" means"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Each request is served by a **live DSH agent session** (the harness `agents` registry + the agent lo"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"op), so every call gets the agent's full world: its configured tools, bash/files access, skills, pro"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"mpt sections, and preset persona. This is an **agent gateway**, not a thin LLM proxy:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- The **agent owns tool use**. Client-side `tools` / `tool_choice` / function-call messages are reje"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"cted on both endpoints (`/v1/responses` no longer ignores them silently) — the agent decides what to"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ols to call and why.
- Chat deltas arrive **once per committed assistant message**, not per token. R"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"esponses sends lifecycle events first and the accumulated text after the turn ends. Neither endpoint"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" exposes reasoning, tool calls or token-level chunks.
- `/v1/responses` sends its `response.created`"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" / `in_progress` lifecycle events as soon as the turn starts, so a long answer never looks hung, and"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" a mid-turn failure closes the stream with an explicit `event: error`. A chat stream that dies mid-t"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"urn now emits an error frame before `[DONE]`.
- The first request for a `(key, preset, session)` tri"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ple **seeds** a session by rendering the client's full message array into a labeled transcript promp"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"t; later requests admit only the latest user turn (the session already holds the history)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Session identity"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`(API key tenant, X-Agent-Preset, X-Session-Id)`:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- The accepted **apiKey namespaces the caller** — one session per key, so different keys never share"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" a session even for the same preset, and a client resumes its own session on reconnect.
- The **`X-A"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"gent-Preset` header** names the preset the session joins (absent → the profile default). Resolved on"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ly at session creation.
- The optional **`X-Session-Id` header** (usually a URL-encoded role name) s"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"plits sessions further per role and is used as the session title. The mapping is persisted, so a pro"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"file restart resumes the previous session; a session that has been archived is recreated."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The package declares a DSH bundle and automatically contributes the `openai-api` component when newl"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"y installed into a profile, so no manual `insert:` is needed. Installing it from the Desktop Plugins"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" page and choosing **Enable now** applies immediately; installing through the CLI requires a profile"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" choosing **Enable now** applies immediately; installing through the CLI requires a profile restart."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"For DSH Desktop, initialize the app once, fully quit it, and use the desktop app's bundled `dsh` com"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"mand with `--profile desktop` instead of `--profile web` (register it from the app's **Manage dsh Co"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"mmand…** menu). The npm-installed CLI cannot manage the desktop profile. You can also install this p"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ackage from the desktop Plugins page using the GitHub spec or an absolute local checkout path, then "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"choose **Enable now**."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Desktop uses a dynamically assigned HTTP port by default, rather than `3080`. Use its actual listeni"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ng address as the API base URL — the **API** row at the sidebar foot shows it, so the port never has"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" to be hunted down; `GET /v1/models` checks that the plugin is running without calling a model."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"To customize the component, update the existing row in the profile's user patch layer — `$DSH_HOME/p"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"rofiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (or `profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` for Desktop):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Omit an optional key entirely rather than writing an empty value. `apiKeys: []` now means the same a"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"s omitting it (the keyless loopback tenant), but `provider: ''` and `cwd: ''` are still rejected: `p"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rovider` must be a non-empty string and `cwd` an absolute path."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Restart the profile after editing its configuration."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Sidebar panel"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Once the plugin is enabled, an **API** row appears at the sidebar foot (above Settings), styled like"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" the harness's own To-dos row: icon, title, muted port, chevron. It starts collapsed; clicking it re"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"veals the detail **upwards** (the toggle keeps its place first in the DOM, so tab and screen-reader "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"order are unchanged), and the chevron flips down while open."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **After the first successful open**, the collapsed row retains the port. Desktop shows the actual "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"runtime-assigned HTTP port.
- **Expanding checks once by itself**: it reads the descriptor, then req"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"uests `GET <prefix>/models` — that lists models and never calls one.
- **The result shares the row w"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ith the button**: blue dot when the surface answers, red when it does not. The **Detect** button app"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ears **only when the surface is unreachable**, as a retry; a `401` means the surface answered and wa"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"nts a key, which counts as healthy and shows no button.
- **Base URL** is generated from the live li"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"stener and copies in one click; **Usage example** expands to a curl line and every endpoint path.
- "},{"id":"p25s8","text":"**Auth / Model id** show whether a key is required, or that the surface is keyless and loopback-only"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"*Auth / Model id** show whether a key is required, or that the surface is keyless and loopback-only."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The first open shows the full form with placeholder values. Subsequent opens keep the previous addre"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ss and port visible while refreshing the descriptor and probing, rather than clearing the content fi"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"nd port visible while refreshing the descriptor and probing, rather than clearing the content first."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Hovering or opening uses the same fill as the settings and account navigation rows (a theme token, s"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"o it follows light and dark). The detail is height-capped and scrolls internally, so it never pushes"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" out of the sidebar."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"When the host displays a collapsed 56px rail, the entry becomes an icon button with details beside i"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"t.
